map.不含税 = 含税 ÷ (1 + 税率) 使用指南: Excl. Tax = Incl. Tax ÷ (1 + Rate) — User Guide
map.输入含税金额与增值税税率，按 不含税=含税÷(1+税率) 将含税价拆分为不含税销: Enter the tax-inclusive amount and VAT rate to split the tax-inclusive price into tax-exclusive sales and tax payable via excl. = incl. ÷ (1 + rate), for restoring tax-inclusive payments to tax-exclusive revenue and tax in reimbursements and bookkeeping.
map.把含税金额按增值税率拆出不含税销售额与税额。: Split the tax-inclusive amount into tax-exclusive sales and tax by the VAT rate.
map.已知含税金额反算不含税金额与增值税额。: Back out the tax-exclusive amount and VAT from a tax-inclusive amount.
map.采购、报销时做价税分离入账。: Do price-tax separation for procurement and reimbursement bookkeeping.
map.确认含税价里含的税有多少可抵扣。: Confirm how much of the tax in the tax-inclusive price is deductible.
map.：含税 109 时不含税 = 109/1.09 = 100 元，税额 9 元。: : at incl. 109, tax-exclusive = 109/1.09 = 100 CNY, tax 9 CNY.
map.为什么含税÷(1+率)？: Why divide incl. tax by (1 + rate)?
map.因为含税价=不含税价×(1+率)，反推不含税价须除以 (1+率)。: Because tax-inclusive price = tax-exclusive price × (1 + rate), so back-solving the tax-exclusive price requires dividing by (1 + rate).
map.一般纳税人可抵扣的是哪部分？: Which part can a general taxpayer deduct?
map.取得的专票上注明的增值税额（即本工具算出的税额，符合规定时）可抵扣。: The VAT noted on the special invoice obtained (i.e. the tax this tool computes, when rules are met) is deductible.
